about: Block Party's items. What each one does is the game's code; this file says what it's called and how it looks. docs/plans/block-party.md, "The items file", says what each setting does. A texture is a path in Block Party's pack or Minecraft's own (textures/items/totem); the build makes the screens' icons from it, so there is nothing to run.

stone_totem.name: Stone Totem
stone_totem.description: Roll an extra die this turn.

golden_totem.name: Golden Totem
golden_totem.description: Roll an extra die that counts double, this turn.

cursed_totem.name: Cursed Totem
cursed_totem.description: A rival's next roll is halved.

lightning.name: Lightning Strike
lightning.description: The leader gives 10 coins to last place.

zombie.name: Zombie Spawn
zombie.description: A zombie follows a rival and takes 3 coins a round.

iron_golem.name: Iron Golem
iron_golem.description: Shake a player down for 5 coins, or send your zombie away.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: Trade a die or an item for half its value.
